descriptionChirho: A flower or blossom, used of literal botanical blooms (e.g., almond blossoms on the menorah in Exodus 25, 37; Aaron's budding rod in Numbers 17) and metaphorically for the transient beauty of human life (Isaiah 40:6-7; Job 14:2; Nahum 1:4), covering the full range from bud to open flower.
